card.name: Risks in estrogen dosing advice
card.fires_on: The word "risks" in the estrogen label phrase "consistent with treatment goals and risks for the individual woman". It also fires weakly on similar risk words in benefit-risk statements.

modes.label: Estrogen lowest-dose phrase
modes.description: "Risks" ending the phrase about treatment goals and risks for the individual woman.
modes.example: individual risk profile. Prescribe estrogens with or without progestogens at the lowest effective doses and for the shortest duration consistent with treatment goals and<< risks>> for the individual woman. WARNING: CARD

modes.label: Other risk wording
modes.description: A risk word in a benefit-risk or fracture-risk statement in other drug labels.
modes.example: ide Injection for more than 2 years during a patient’s lifetime should only be considered if a patient remains at or has returned to having a high risk<< for>> fracture ( 2.3 )

card.writes: It may push words about priority or preference, such as "priorit" and "prefers", which fits weighing goals against risks.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "risks" in the standard estrogen advice to use the lowest dose for the shortest time.
